annotation.title_clean: A new legislative framework for products that is fit for the digital and sustainable transition
annotation.title_en: A new legislative framework for products that is fit for the digital and sustainable transition
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament own-initiative resolution (21 Oct 2025) urging revision of the New Legislative Framework for product legislation. It calls for a horizontal digital product passport, stronger market surveillance, clearer economic operator duties, circular-economy definitions, better harmonised standards and stronger notified body accreditation, with consistency with the AI Act. Robotics is not addressed specifically.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for horizontal, interoperable digital product passport possibly replacing declarations of conformity
Urges mandatory EU responsible person with greater liability for non-EU traders
Calls for stronger market surveillance and assessment of an EU market surveillance authority
Proposes review of conformity assessment modules and mandatory accreditation of notified bodies
Wants conformity assessment to address software updates, connectivity and AI altering products after placing on market
